text:
incident-bot: PAGE · severity=P1 · service=inference-api · region=us-west-2 · symptom=error_rate>5% on /v1/generate — paged @sre-oncall and @maria

sre-oncall: I'm on it, taking pager. starting triage now.

maria: thanks — seeing 500s coming from the model gateway, spikes at ~12:34 UTC. rolling fallback plan in case model host pool is unhealthy.

alex: putting note here: traffic to small-model variant is healthy, but routing layer failing 502->500 conversion. stack traces attached in logs.

sre-oncall: mitigation 1: enable fallback route to model-small for critical routes. i'll flip the flag and watch.

maria: copy. command i'm running: ```
# enable fallback
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/config -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"model-small","active":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```

jamie: ping when you flip, i'll watch customer-facing metrics and post updates to status.redwood.ai

sre-oncall: flipped at 12:38 UTC. error rate dropped from 5.8% -> 0.9% within 3 mins. rolling back can wait until we know root cause.

alex: grabbing node logs, seeing OOM spikes on host pool gpu-03 and gcpu-proxy timeout exceptions. suspect kernel-level mem fragmentation after a large batch job earlier.

maria: confirmed a large batch inference job from a scheduled test the previous hour pushed mem high on a subset of nodes. autoscale didn't pick up due to quota threshold bug. filing immediate mitigations and longer-term follow-ups.

sre-oncall: live mitigation notes: 1) fallback route enabled (owner: maria) 2) drained ggpu-03 and restarted model agent (owner: alex) 3) temporary increase of autoscale threshold to allow faster replacement (owner: sre-oncall).

pm-oliver: thanks all. customer-impact quick summary: observed 72 customer requests errored (predominantly small PLG customers) between 12:33–12:39 UTC; no data loss reported. will need a post-incident triage + postmortem.

jamie: suggest postmortem kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. who can own the writeup? @jamie can coordinate but need technical lead for timeline + contrib factors.

maria: happy to own the technical writeup (timeline, contributing factors, mitigation steps). i'll draft timeline and initial RCA sections.

alex: i'll help with logs/evidence and put together the exact host timelines and commands executed.

pm-oliver: assigning owners/action items here — please reply with ack and ETA for your sections.

maria: ACK. ETA for draft timeline + contributing factors: EOD tomorrow.

alex: ACK. ETA for evidence bundle and logs: tomorrow noon PT.

jamie: ACK. i'll produce impact summary, customer list, and outreach recommendations by tomorrow 3pm PT.

legal: quick flag — if outreach template touches contract language, loop us in. otherwise we'll review before publish.

devex: can we include a short blurb for the SDK status page? i can draft once we have the postmortem.

sre-oncall: creating postmortem doc now -> link: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/2143658700-draft (draft).

maria: started timeline section in the doc, added exact command snippets and node IDs.

alex: uploaded logs tarball to evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/2143658700/logs.tar.gz

pm-oliver: plan for peer review: tech leads (maria + alex) produce draft, then peer review by SRE + Product + Legal, final sign-off by EngVP. aiming for sign-off within 48h.

jamie: noted. scheduling peer review block for 24h after draft in calendar.

maria: draft ready for review — link to doc, please comment inline: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/2143658700-draft#timeline

alex: quick review done, added notes on autoscale quota bug and proposed remediation (increase monitoring on scheduled batch jobs + kill switch for large tests).

legal: reviewed outreach language, minor edits suggested.

devex: added SDK status blurb and recommended wording for changelog.

pm-oliver: all reviewers, please add explicit LGTM or request changes.

jamie: LGTM from PM side.

alex: LGTM after addressing one inline comment about exact mem metrics.

maria: final edits made. moving to sign-off.

sre-oncall: EngVP sign-off requested at 2024-07-15T18:00Z — awaiting.

eng-vp: sign-off: reviewed timeline & actions. approving postmortem for publication after minor wording change on customer outreach.

pm-oliver: postmortem status: DRAFT -> APPROVED. action items recap:
- fix autoscale quota bug (owner: eng-runtime, ETA: 2 weeks)
- add pre-flight checks to large batch jobs (owner: eng-ml, ETA: 1 week)
- implement kill switch for scheduled tests (owner: eng-infra, ETA: 3 days)
- update status page & SDK blurb (owner: devex, ETA: 48h)

maria: adding remediation tickets to tracker and assigning owners. ticket links in doc.

jamie: i'll coordinate customer notifications with legal and support; draft emails in the doc for review.

incident-bot: Incident closed at 12:55 UTC — mitigation successful, postmortem scheduled and approved. :white_check_mark:

pm-oliver: great work team — thanks for the quick mitigation and the thorough writeup. we'll follow up in the weekly ops review to make sure action items are tracked to completion. :thumbsup:
